q26Merge.question: Q26: can intents be added to an already sealed (proven, bound) transaction, and does stagenet accept it?
q26Merge.answer: yes: two fee-less sealed publications were merged, the wallet added a fee intent after sealing, and stagenet included the result with status SUCCESS

intent hash stable from unproven to sealed (B)

sealed B carries only its publication intent (no fee intent)
merged transaction holds exactly the two publication segments
